referenceProfile: Apple M5 / 16GiB, Chromium 4x CPU throttling for latency; no population-percentile claim
selectionAuthority: Owner delegated representative hardware and budget choices on 2026-10-21

latencyPolicy.baseline: Two complete sessions, each 3 warmup plus 9 recorded navigations for each of seven configurations
latencyPolicy.initialLimits: For each action median and nearest-rank p95, take the larger session observation, add 25%, then round upward to 10ms
latencyPolicy.meaning: Reproducible regression ceilings, not a universal UX SLO, physical-input delay, paint timing or INP
latencyPolicy.futureUpdates: Never recalculate a budget during verification; review failures and any proposed new baseline explicitly

bundlePolicy.initialLimits: 10% headroom above the composed fixture's emitted JS/CSS gzip9 totals, rounded upward to 1KiB
bundlePolicy.meaning: Composed fixture output, not a minimal application route transfer size

memory.window: 25 recorded post-GC mount/dispose cycles after 5 warmups in each of seven configurations
memory.required: Active-update disposal, cleared owned DOM/portal/timer/frame state, no late publication, complete raw counters and snapshot retaining-path review
memory.meaning: Bounded whole-page regression ceiling; no zero-growth, perpetual plateau or universal leak-free claim
